title: Durchsuchungen und Festnahmen nach Angriff und Schussabgaben auf 31-Jährigen

extraction.summaryEn: Several men shot repeatedly at a 31-year-old in front of a convenience store in Haselhorst on 11 December 2025, seriously injuring him. On 21 January 2026 police raided 14 addresses citywide and arrested suspects aged 21 to 28.
